notes.title: Giant Cop Update – Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hey Micro City visitors,

We are happy to bring you our first Steam patch for both Vive and Oculus Users, the following optimizations and bug fixes have been implemented:

[list]
[*]Add Haptic feedback to Vive controls
[*]Added disconnect prompts for Oculus Rift hardware
[*]Fixed an error where the shake gesture recognition required more force than intended
[*]Fixed an error where the “Quit to Steam” button didn’t show text with French Language enabled
[*]Additional bug-fixes & stability improvements
[/list] 

Thanks everyone for your feedback and support.   If you find something you want to report please email us at support@giantcop.com

Cheers!
